name: mirror_bath
description: a cracked mirror hanging crookedly. your reflection fractures into unsettling, fragmented versions of yourself. one fragment doesn't move when you do.

params.success_message: you stare at the mirror, focusing on the fragment that doesn't match your movement. it's not a reflection — it's something behind the mirror, watching you. you see the outline of a small handprint on the other side of the glass.
